Premium editorial product photography, calm, tactile, simple and meticulous, suitable for a spacious Apple-inspired marketing card while remaining an original PyColors composition. The page background will be deep violet, so retain clean luminous ivory edges. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or rectangular backdrop, no opaque vignette. No text, letters, code, numerals, logos, Apple products, screens, interface, people, watermarks, badges or extra props. Avoid cartoon clipart, an app icon tile, excessive gloss, neon glows, random floating ornaments and busy scenery.
